contact_edits.before: Still, it's Christmas, and one wants to be nice, and there are worse ways of spending a holiday night out. The cast still rise splendidly to the odd improvisational challenge when a punter comes out with an unexpected response, and even when one doesn't. And, something that sets this dinner theatre apart from most others, the dinner part of the equation is very strong. Order with confidence, from a staff who remain charming and considerate and who, in some cases, have been there for years. Such ensemble consistency is rare, in restaurants as in theatres. The management must be doing something right. - Dancing With Stars Can Be Murder is playing at Mysteriously Yours ...Mystery Dinner Theatre's New Year's Eve Mystery Gala. Call 416-486-7469 or 1-800-668-3323 for tickets and information.
